title: Conversation 2026-11-04: each essay has its own semantic context

sections.name: narrative
sections.content: Starting from the status of the essay home, the owner asked whether an essay has the packages its help assumes and whether an agent can create new types. Findings: a new essay has essay and comments only; the argument package is neither installed nor installable from the editor; no agent tool defines a type. The owner chose the argument package as a dependency for now, with agent help to teach it, and then described where the editor is going: each essay has its own semantic context, and the editor presents it in layers.
